experiments.paper_location: Section 4.4; sparse neural network module, backward propagation
experiments.mechanism: Accumulate deeper-layer sparse gradients and propagate ReLU-gated deltas using column-major weights.

conditions.execution: CPU serial execution of extracted maintained CUDA body
conditions.previous_activations: positive, zero and negative; sparse noncontiguous IDs
conditions.initial_state: nonzero previous deltas, weight gradients and bias gradients
conditions.oracle: independent dense masked outer products and matrix-vector products

experiments.note: Checks every physical gradient and bias element, compressed previous-delta ordering, repeated accumulation, output-buffer canaries and borrowed CSC preservation. Existing previous deltas are added only for positive activations; nonpositive activations overwrite previous deltas with zero but their actual values still multiply the weight gradients. One-thread shared-memory execution does not validate CUDA synchronization, parallel atomics, races or host dispatch.

experiments.note: Checks the independent dense oracle rather than comparing against another kernel variant. Non-square physical encodings expose incorrect weight strides.
